typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		RPT_DT as timestamp,
		PLTFM_TXT as string,
		ENVRN_TXT as string,
		DATABASENAME as string,
		CREATE_DT as timestamp,
		ENCRYPT_CD as string,
		USER_CT as integer,
		APPL_ID_CT as integer,
		NON_US_BASED_USER_CT as integer,
		DB_OBJ_CT as integer,
		TBL_CT as integer,
		VIEW_CT as integer,
		MACRO_CT as integer,
		SP_CT as integer,
		PROXY_RIGHT_CT as integer,
		QRY_CT as integer,
		QRY_WNDW_DY_CT as integer,
		LAST_QRY_DT as timestamp,
		MAX_PERM_SPACE_GB as integer,
		CURRENT_PERM_SPACE_GB as integer,
		FREE_PERM_SPACE_GB as integer,
		PERM_SPACE_UTLZ_PCT as integer,
		REC_CT as integer,
		REC_CT_COLL_DT as timestamp,
		TBL_GT_90DY_CT as integer,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_CREATE_DT as timestamp,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_ALTER_DT as timestamp,
		CONTACT_EMP_ID as integer,
		CNTCT_FULL_NAME as string,
		CNTCT_EMAIL_ADDR as string,
		CNTCT_AU_NUM as integer,
		CNTCT_AU_NAME as string,
		CREATE_DTTM as timestamp,
		LAST_UPD_DTTM as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT RPT_DT       ,PLTFM_TXT       ,ENVRN_TXT       ,DATABASENAME       ,CREATE_DT       ,ENCRYPT_CD       ,USER_CT       ,APPL_ID_CT       ,NON_US_BASED_USER_CT       ,DB_OBJ_CT       ,TBL_CT       ,VIEW_CT       ,MACRO_CT       ,SP_CT       ,PROXY_RIGHT_CT       ,QRY_CT       ,QRY_WNDW_DY_CT       ,LAST_QRY_DT       ,MAX_PERM_SPACE_GB       ,CURRENT_PERM_SPACE_GB       ,FREE_PERM_SPACE_GB       ,PERM_SPACE_UTLZ_PCT       ,REC_CT       ,REC_CT_COLL_DT       ,TBL_GT_90DY_CT       ,LAST_TBL_DDL_CREATE_DT       ,LAST_TBL_DDL_ALTER_DT       ,CONTACT_EMP_ID       ,CNTCT_FULL_NAME       ,CNTCT_EMAIL_ADDR       ,CNTCT_AU_NUM       ,CNTCT_AU_NAME       ,CREATE_DTTM       ,LAST_UPD_DTTM   FROM SBXAPP.RPT_SANDBOX_SUMMARY_FILE  /* WHERE CREATE_DTTM  BETWEEN  TRUNC(SYSDATE, \'MM\') and TRUNC(SYSDATE,\'DD\') */ WHERE RPT_DT > ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(TO_DATE(SYSDATE), \'MM\'), -3)',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource	source(output(
		sandbox_name as string,
		platform_name as string,
		environment_name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select sandbox_name 	, platform_name 	, environment_name from ESIMS_ETL.sbx.tbl_sas_master_list where IsActive = 1',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
OLEDBSource,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(ENVRN_TXT == environment_name && PLTFM_TXT == platform_name && DATABASENAME == sandbox_name,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup filter(isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		APPL_ID_CT as string,
		USER_CT as string,
		CNTCT_AU_NAME as string,
		RPT_DT as string,
		DB_OBJ_CT as string,
		CNTCT_AU_NUM as string,
		CURRENT_PERM_SPACE_GB as string,
		CNTCT_EMAIL_ADDR as string,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_CREATE_DT as string,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_ALTER_DT as string,
		TBL_CT as string,
		ENVRN_TXT as string,
		CREATE_DT as string,
		LAST_QRY_DT as string,
		MAX_PERM_SPACE_GB as string,
		PLTFM_TXT as string,
		DATABASENAME as string,
		REC_CT as string,
		CONTACT_EMP_ID as string,
		ENCRYPT_CD as string,
		NON_US_BASED_USER_CT as string,
		QRY_CT as string,
		CNTCT_FULL_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		APPL_ID_CT,
		USER_CT,
		CNTCT_AU_NAME,
		RPT_DT,
		DB_OBJ_CT,
		CNTCT_AU_NUM,
		CURRENT_PERM_SPACE_GB,
		CNTCT_EMAIL_ADDR,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_CREATE_DT,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_ALTER_DT,
		TBL_CT,
		ENVRN_TXT,
		CREATE_DT,
		LAST_QRY_DT,
		MAX_PERM_SPACE_GB,
		PLTFM_TXT,
		DATABASENAME,
		REC_CT,
		CONTACT_EMP_ID,
		ENCRYPT_CD,
		NON_US_BASED_USER_CT,
		QRY_CT,
		CNTCT_FULL_NAME)) ~> OLEDBDestination
